summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Bible Bytes Producer MVP. 32 pytest cases covering auth (login/me/refresh/logout/change-password/lockout), admin users (create/role change/reset/deactivate/self-protect), settings (public/admin/update/mask/test-provider with fake key), reference documents (upload template deactivates previous, example toggle/view/delete, non-.docx rejection, import creates published episode), and episodes (CRUD, similar matching by chapter+theme, outline/script versioning, approval/publish/reopen flow, invalid transitions, docx export, search/filter, meta) — ALL 32 PASSED. Frontend smoke-tested via Playwright across Login, Dashboard, Settings (AI/Docs/Users tabs), New Episode intake (similar-episode banner with 'Same chapter: Genesis 16 · Shared theme: grace, identity' confirmed), Outline Write-it-myself + Save version + Approve (status moves to Outline Approved and Script tab unlocks), Generate-with-fake-key error path (outline-error testid shows 'API key not valid'), Library search, Account page. Fake API keys cleared and UI_/TEST_ seed data deleted post-run. Admin NOT locked out (used throwaway usernames for 429 test).

minor.issue: update_settings uses exclude_none=True then strips strings, so sending gemini_api_key='' DOES overwrite the saved key (sets to empty). Spec expects 'leaving key blank keeps saved key'. UI appears to compensate by only sending the field when non-empty (reload shows placeholder 'Leave blank to keep the saved key'), but the API itself has no 'blank==keep' semantics. If any client sends empty string it will clear the key.

When no API key is configured, the endpoint still returns 200 and sets generating=... then the background task fails and surfaces 'No API key set' via last_error. Spec requested a direct 400 'No API key set'. Not a functional bug (error is surfaced in UI via outline-error) but inconsistent with the spec.
No DELETE user endpoint exists — admin can only deactivate. Test-generated producer accounts accumulate in the Users list across runs.

issues: Welcome hero text ('Grace and peace, Administrator') and subtitle use very light stone color on cream background — low contrast, may fail WCAG AA for body text.

Masked API key field is rendered as an empty input with placeholder 'Leave blank to keep the saved key' and a 'No key' pill even when a key IS stored (because API returns gemini_api_key_masked only when a key exists but the input's value is always ''). Consider showing the mask value (••••••••abcd) in the input or a 'Key saved' indicator rather than 'No key'.

action_items: Decide intended semantics for PUT /api/settings with empty api_key string: either preserve existing (treat '' as 'keep') or document that empty clears. Current UI happens to work only because it omits the field.
Return 400 'No API key set' synchronously from POST /episodes/{id}/{stage}/generate (per spec) instead of starting a background task that fails.
Settings > AI: fix the 'No key' / masked display so admins can see a key is stored (show gemini_api_key_masked value, flip 'No key' pill to 'Key set').
Improve contrast of Dashboard greeting text.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login_attempts lockout key is '{ip}:{username}' which is good — not DOS-able across users. Bcrypt + httpOnly cookies look correct.

episodes.py uses background asyncio.create_task without awaiting; _tasks set is used to retain references — fine for single process but will not survive reload (handled at startup via resetting generating flag with 'Generation interrupted' — nice).
admin.py update_settings strips strings for every key except extra_instructions; combined with exclude_none it causes '' to overwrite saved api keys. See action item.
episodes.py uses db.settings.update_many with `{'generating': {'$ne': None}}` on startup — good self-healing.

server.py CORS: when CORS_ORIGINS='*' the middleware is NOT added (only non-* explicit origins trigger it). Since the frontend is served from the same origin via ingress, CORS isn't needed; just note that '*' is effectively ignored.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical smoke flows (login, settings, intake+similar banner, outline write/save/approve, fake-key error surface, library search, account)

test_credentials: admin / <redacted> (verified login via UI + API). Producer accounts created and discarded during tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest fixtures create+teardown their own episodes/users/docs with TEST_ prefix. Playwright test created a few UI_* episodes and sample template docs; all were deleted at end of run. Fake Gemini key was CLEARED from settings post-run (gemini_configured=false, openai_configured=false confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest-based and self-contained — just run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py`. It creates/removes its own data. The lockout test uses throwaway usernames to avoid locking admin. If re-running, remember PUT /settings with empty string DOES clear API keys (bug noted). The UI 'intake-primary-scripture-input' is actually `intake-scripture-input`; other testids: intake-title/episode-number/topic/scripture/themes/supporting/length/audience/guidance-input, intake-submit-button, intake-save-draft-button, intake-similar-warning-banner, episode-title, tab-outline, tab-script, outline-error. Approve button text 'Approve outline'/'Approve script', save button text 'Save version'.
